- What it does (paraphrased): the platforms field lists which OSes can install/run the extension; use it when your extension uses platform-specific APIs so you can restrict install to those OSes.

- Valid values (quote): "macOS" or "Windows"

- Required / default if omitted: the doc presents platforms as a required extension property, so there is no supported default — you must specify the supported platforms (i.e., you should not omit it).

- Store / user effect (paraphrased): the Store and installers use that array to determine which users can download or install the extension on their machine; only the listed platforms will be allowed to install it.

- Menu-bar / mode notes (quotes and paraphrase):
  - The manifest supports a command mode called "menu-bar": "\"menu-bar\" indicates that this command will return a [Menu Bar Extra]".
  - Because menu bar extras are a platform-specific UI concept, treat menu-bar commands as platform-specific and restrict platforms accordingly (e.g., include the OS that supports menu bar extras in your platforms array).

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Raycast for Windows is currently in public beta as of November 2025, and our extension already has the platform set to macOS only, which prevents it from showing up in the Windows Store. Even if we changed that, menu bar commands aren't supported on Windows anyway, so there's a fundamental blocker there.

Beyond that, there are several implementation gaps: our binary detection hardcodes macOS paths like `/opt/homebrew/bin` and `~/.cargo/bin`, while Windows would need to check `%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin` and package manager paths. The config file location defaults to `~/Library/Application Support/pueue/pueue.yml` instead of the Windows equivalent under `%APPDATA%`. We also assume `sh -c` for running commands, but Windows uses PowerShell or cmd, and our documentation mentions launchd which is macOS-specific. SSH connections might work if OpenSSH is installed on Windows, but there are quoting and path expansion differences to handle.
</details></think>

175	  return parseConnections(prefs().connections).invalid;
176	}
177	
178	export function defaultConnection(): Connection {
179	  return connections()[0];
180	}
181	
182	/** Look a connection up by name, falling back to local rather than throwing. */
183	export function connectionByName(name: string | undefined): Connection {
184	  const all = connections();
185	  return all.find((c) => c.name === name) ?? all[0];
186	}
187	
188	/**
189	 * The directory pueue keeps state and logs in.
190	 *
191	 * `pueue_directory` in the config wins if it is set to something other than
192	 * null; otherwise macOS's data dir, which is the same path as the config dir.
193	 * Probed with a regex rather than a YAML parser — one optional key does not
194	 * justify a dependency, and a miss only costs us the on-disk log fast path.
195	 */
196	export function pueueDirectory(): string | undefined {
197	  const cfg = configPath() ?? join(MACOS_PUEUE_DIR, "pueue.yml");
198	  try {
199	    const yaml = readFileSync(cfg, "utf8");
200	    const m =
201	      /^\s*pueue_directory:\s*(?!null\s*$)(?:"([^"]+)"|'([^']+)'|(\S+))\s*$/m.exec(
202	        yaml,
203	      );
204	    const dir = m?.[1] ?? m?.[2] ?? m?.[3];
205	    if (dir) return dir.replace(/^~(?=\/|$)/, homedir());
206	  } catch {
207	    // No readable config — fall back to the platform default below.
208	  }
209	  return existsSync(MACOS_PUEUE_DIR) ? MACOS_PUEUE_DIR : undefined;
210	}
211	
212	/**
213	 * Where a task's captured output lives on disk.
214	 *
215	 * stdout and stderr are written to this one file, interleaved, uncompressed,
216	 * with no timestamps or stream markers. Reading it directly is what `pueue log`
217	 * itself does when `client.read_local_logs` is true (the default).
218	 */
219	export function taskLogPath(id: number): string | undefined {
220	  const dir = pueueDirectory();
221	  return dir ? join(dir, "task_logs", `${id}.log`) : undefined;
222	}
223	
224	export function resolveBrew(): string | undefined {
225	  for (const candidate of ["/opt/homebrew/bin/brew", "/usr/local/bin/brew"]) {
226	    if (existsSync(candidate)) return candidate;
227	  }
228	  return undefined;
229	}
230	
231	/**
232	 * True when pueued is managed by `brew services` on this machine.
233	 *
234	 * Gates the one-click "Start Daemon" action. Starting `pueued -d` from Raycast
235	 * would make the daemon a child of Raycast's launchd process, so every task it
236	 * later ran would inherit Raycast's minimal environment — the same PATH problem
237	 * as above, except it silently poisons every future task instead of failing
238	 * loudly once. Only offer the button when we can hand the job to launchd.
239	 */
240	export function isBrewManagedDaemon(): boolean {
241	  return (
242	    resolveBrew() !== undefined &&
243	    existsSync(
244	      join(homedir(), "Library", "LaunchAgents", "homebrew.mxcl.pueue.plist"),
245	    )
246	  );
247	}
248	
249	/** Reset the probe caches. Only used by tests and preference changes. */
250	export function clearBinaryCache(): void {
251	  cachedPueue = undefined;
252	  cachedPueued = undefined;
253	}

_**Agent (claude-opus-5 2026-07-27 07:27:55Z)**_

## 短答：不行，而且是我們自己擋掉的

`package.json:13-15` 已經宣告 `"platforms": ["macOS"]`。官方 schema 對這欄位的說明是：

> If not present, the extension is assumed to be available on all platforms.

也就是說「不寫」才是全平台，我們是明確寫死 macOS。Store 依這個欄位決定誰能安裝，所以 Windows 使用者在 Store 裡根本不會看到它。這個宣告是對的——下面的東西沒有一項會在 Windows 上動。

## Raycast Windows 現況

公開 beta（目前 `v0.70.0.0 Beta`，2025-11 起公開 beta）。官方說法是「All extensions that do not require native code will work out of the box on both platforms」——我們不算 native code，但算「native 環境假設」，差別在下面。

## 就算把 flag 打開，卡在這幾點

| 問題 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| **menu-bar 命令 Windows 不支援**，官方文件原話「Menubar commands aren't available on Windows.」而 `platforms` **只存在於 extension 層級**（我對照過官方 schema，command item 只有 `mode`/`interval`/`preferences`… 沒有 `platforms`）——所以沒辦法「Windows 版少一個命令」，只能整包二選一 | `package.json` `queue-menu` |
| binary 探測全是 macOS 路徑，而且 `join(dir, "pueue")` 沒有 `.exe` | `src/lib/pueue/binary.ts:33-40` |
| config / log 目錄寫死 `~/Library/Application Support/pueue`，Windows 是 `%APPDATA%\pueue` | `src/lib/pueue/binary.ts:43-48`、`:197`、`:209` |
| `brew services` + LaunchAgents plist 偵測，是「Start Daemon」按鈕的唯一 gate。pueue v4 在 Windows 是走 Windows service，整段邏輯要重寫 | `src/lib/pueue/binary.ts:224-247` |
| 整頁錯誤說明是 launchd / Homebrew 敘事 | `src/lib/error-states.tsx:133-137` |
| SSH 連線多工用 ControlMaster/ControlPath，Windows 內建的 OpenSSH 至今沒實作連線多工——遠端連線不會壞，但每次呼叫都要重新握手，menu bar 每分鐘一次會很痛 | `src/lib/pueue/ssh.ts:56-62` |
| AI tool 說明寫「runs through `sh -c`, so pipes and && work as typed」，在 Windows 上是錯的 | `package.json` `add-task` tool description |

**pueue 本身不是阻礙**——官方有 `pueue-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe`，v4 也加了 Windows service 支援。純粹是我們這層的假設。

## 建議

維持 macOS-only。真要做的話工作量集中在 `binary.ts` / `error-states.tsx` / `ssh.ts` 三個檔，但 `queue-menu` 得整個砍掉才有資格宣告 Windows——而它是這個 extension 蠻核心的一塊。

更關鍵的是：我們沒有 Windows 機器能從 Raycast 裡面實測。這個專案每一個回報過的 bug 都是 `just check` 看不到、只有互動測試才會現形的——在 Windows 上宣告支援卻只驗證過型別，等於保證會出事。

Sources:
- [Manifest — Raycast API](https://developers.raycast.com/information/manifest)
- [Menu Bar Commands — Raycast API](https://developers.raycast.com/api-reference/menu-bar-commands)
- [Raycast for Windows](https://www.raycast.com/windows)
- [Prepare an Extension for Store](https://developers.raycast.com/basics/prepare-an-extension-for-store)
- [Nukesor/pueue releases](https://github.com/nukesor/pueue/releases)
- [pueued Windows service support #344](https://github.com/Nukesor/pueue/issues/344)
